messages:
carmen: quick thread on form validation + confirmation copy for the Keys page. two quick calls: when to show inline errors, and how explicit should delete modals be?

eli: validate on blur + on submit. don't validate on every keystroke except for trivial rules (length/allowed chars). inline hints should be one short line; put examples in a collapsible 'examples' panel.

nora: accessibility: when showing a top summary after submit, move focus to it and use role="alert" so screen readers announce it. link each summary line to the field via anchors. set aria-invalid on errored inputs.

sam: required-field pattern: prefer marking optional fields with '(optional)' rather than asterisks everywhere. if we do asterisks, add a legend like '* required' at the top. avoid relying on color alone for required/error states.

eli: destructive copy suggestion: avoid 'Are you sure?'. be explicit about consequences and require typed-confirm for high-risk deletes. sample:

Dialog title: Delete API key "seed-123"?
Body: This will permanently revoke the key. Any services using it will stop working. Type the key name to confirm.
Confirm: Delete "seed-123" (danger)
Cancel: Keep key

sam: CTA order: cancel left, destructive primary right (red). ESC closes modal and returns focus to origin. if resource has dependents, list them (e.g., '3 running jobs') in the body.

a11y-bot: checklist: [move focus to summary on submit, role=alert for summary, aria-invalid + aria-describedby for fields, aria-required where applicable, typed-confirm for critical deletes].

carmen: thanks — I'll update the mock with both optional-label and asterisk-legend variants plus the typed-confirm modal. will ping when Figma is ready.
